menu.label: 9. MIXED SHIFT
menu.title: MIXED SHIFT
menu.blurb: Three to seven threats are drawn fresh each night, each with its own warning and its own answer, paced by a director. Five shifts: three paces, CHAOS with random events and ENDLESS with no dawn.
menu.hint: Each night draws 3 to 7 threats from a pool of eight (QUIET, STEADY and RESTLESS set the pace, CHAOS draws the biggest roster and adds random events, ENDLESS has no dawn): a Counter (builds while you stay on one camera), two Watched (move only when no camera is on them), a Monitor-gated (steps closer as you change the monitor), two Path walkers (walk a route to a door), a Vent crawler (crawls the vent run to one of three office vents) and a Winder (a music box on one camera that must be wound). Every one gives a tell first, and has an answer.
